pages.text: Both axes carry on past 0, like a number line. Left of 0, x is negative, and below 0, y is negative. The axes cut the grid into four [[quadrants]].

pages.alt: A grid with the x-axis across and the y-axis up the side. To the right of 0 and above it the numbers run 1 to 5. The x-axis runs on to the left of 0, to minus 5. The y-axis runs on below 0, to minus 5. The four quadrants are named: top right, top left, bottom left and bottom right. Their signs: top right plus, plus; top left minus, plus; bottom left minus, minus; bottom right plus, minus.

pages.name: Signs flip
pages.text: (−3, 2) means 3 to the left, then 2 up. Watch the signs flip each time the point crosses an axis. Then drag it round yourself.
